q1_name_and_goal.name: DixitGenerator
q1_name_and_goal.goal: Turn uploaded artwork into print-ready A4 duplex PDF sheets of 80 x 120 mm Dixit-format cards, with an overview to organise and batch-select them.

q2_description_nongoals_users.description: Local tool for making custom Dixit cards. Images in; a browser overview organises them by name, tags and notes; any selection exports as A4 sheets at 300 DPI, fronts 2x2 with margin crop marks plus matching back sheets from one chosen back image, registering under duplex printing on a home printer.
non_goals: not a print-service uploader - no MakePlayingCards/PrinterStudio specs; home printer, guillotine, laminator
not internet-facing - localhost, single user, no accounts
not an art tool - artwork is authored elsewhere
not a card designer - no name, text, symbol, frame or border ever prints on a card

q4_toolchain_and_run.run: serve.bat  (VS Code: Terminal > Run Task > 'Overview: serve'), then http://127.0.0.1:8775/web/index.html

q5_verify.method: export fixture batches in all three duplex modes, parse the written PDFs back off disk, and assert page box, card-box positions and sizes, front/back registration, crop-mark clearance and raster resolution; plus a derivation cross-check against published figures the project does not print
q5_verify.note: web/** is mapped to docs/ARCHITECTURE.md but deliberately outside source_globs: exporting a PDF proves nothing about the browser UI. Its check is tests/check_gallery.py (not yet written), which drives a real browser against an already-running server and honours DIXIT_URL.

decisions_2026_09_22.card_size: 80 x 120 mm - the Dixit/Magnum sleeve standard. One retailer lists the raw card at 79 x 120; we print 80 because a hand-cut, laminated card grows rather than shrinks. Recorded as a blind spot on the reference so it is not 'fixed' later.
decisions_2026_09_22.paper: A4 only. Derived 2x2 grid, 4 cards per sheet.
decisions_2026_09_22.duplex: All three modes built (long-edge, short-edge, manual two-file) plus a calibration procedure for per-printer drift. Short-edge additionally rotates the back image 180 degrees.
decisions_2026_09_22.aspect_fit: Crop to fill, centred, with a per-card focus point (0..1 of the source) as the nudge. Stored as two numbers, not a pixel rectangle, so it survives a re-upload at another resolution.
decisions_2026_09_22.cut_guides: Cards touch; crop marks live in the paper margin. 3 mm bleed on the block's OUTER edges only - a shared edge must not bleed onto its neighbour.
decisions_2026_09_22.card_metadata: Name + free tags + notes. Nothing prints on the card; the metadata exists only so the overview can be searched and batch-selected.
decisions_2026_09_22.back_images: A separate 'backs' shelf, not mixed into the card overview - a back is not a playable card.
decisions_2026_09_22.ports: 8775 author / 8776 Claude throwaway. Deliberately different from the sibling CardGenerator's 8765/8766 so both galleries can run at once and a stop command cannot reach the wrong one.
decisions_2026_09_22.pdf_library: reportlab for exact-millimetre placement and vector crop marks; Pillow cannot place. pypdf so the gate can parse its own output back.
decisions_2026_09_22.no_corner_radius: A guillotine cuts square corners; a printed radius then cut square looks worse than none. Corner punch after lamination is the intended finish.

divergences.what: `.claude/settings.json` was written with `enabledPlugins` as an OBJECT map ({"base@claudebase": true}), not the list the base 0.0.3 seed template emits.
divergences.why: Claude Code rejects the list form as a settings file that fails to parse, even though the JSON is syntactically valid -- the mismatch is schema, not syntax. The object form is what both ~/.claude/settings.json and the sibling CardGenerator repo use. This is a Base seed bug; logged as a promotion-ready generic lesson (2 applications) in .claude/learning-log.md.

divergences.what: Both declared references are live websites with no local path, so `protect-references` has nothing to block.
divergences.why: The references are genuinely remote -- there is no published Dixit spec to vendor, and ISO 216 / ISO 32000 are paywalled. Recorded so /base:doctor reporting the guard as dormant reads as expected rather than as breakage.

notes.verify_scope: web/** is mapped to a doc but deliberately left out of source_globs: the gate exports and measures PDFs and says nothing about the browser overview. serve.bat / stop-server.bat / .vscode/tasks.json are launchers, likewise out of source_globs and into README's doc_map.
notes.region_hashing: tools/region_hashes.py computes region_state per /base:sync's region-rewrite.md (content between markers, LF-normalised, trailing-newline-insensitive). It was validated by reproducing all six hashes Base itself wrote into the sibling CardGenerator repo -- run `python tools/region_hashes.py --check --repo <other sub>` to re-prove it.
notes.scaffold_scope: Scaffolded 2026-09-22 with the measurement layer, crop, PDF export and verify gate implemented, so the constitution's central claim is enforced from day one rather than dormant. The store, the JSON API beyond /api/meta, the browser overview and tools/calibration_sheet.py are not started.
